sentences.en: The whole class burst into laughter at the teacher's joke.
sentences.zh: 全班同学听到老师的笑话后都笑了起来。

sentences.en: The girls burst into laughter when they heard his joke.
sentences.zh: 女孩们一听到他的笑话就笑出了声。

sentences.en: As soon as I saw him, I burst into laughter.
sentences.zh: 我一看到他就忍不住笑了出来。

senses.zh: 笑，笑声,〈古〉好笑的事,〈美俚〉力量悬殊得可笑的体育比赛,大笑
